title: RouteResult
description: The answer of POST /api/v2/route/ and the drop link: the route length, the NAVAREAs crossed in order and every active warning within the corridor.

route_nm.description: Route length in nautical miles (rhumb-line legs).

navareas.description: In the order the route enters them.

navarea_id.description: The region id to use with navarea_id=; null for NAVAREA XXI.

results.description: Warnings along the route, most pressing first.

href.description: The warning page on the site, relative.

distance_nm.description: Closest approach of the route to the warning.

along_nm.description: Where along the route the closest point lies.

verdict.description: in_force, upcoming, expired, unknown: the warning's status at the ETA of that point.

ai.description: Compact analysis: headline, category, severity, status, validity.
